limitations: Adversarial browser tests do not measure ordinary reasoning or tool-use reliability.

statement.document_title: Three years on, ChatGPT still isn't what it was cracked up to be – and it probably never will be

from_speaker: don’t work reliably with external tools
our_interpretation: This is a qualified empirical assessment of contemporary models, rather than a prediction.
Latest refers to models available in the posting month. The current reporting window is November 1 through November 29, 2025; older evaluations are context.
Reliability means dependable performance across varied relevant tasks. An isolated mistake or a score below perfection is insufficient by itself.
The comparison with domain-specific models requires named specialist models and matched tasks. Specialized applications are informative but not automatically equivalent to specialized models.
A complete assessment must address the listed components separately.
criteria.support_condition: Contemporary evaluations document substantive reasoning, tool-use, hallucination, control, and alignment limitations, together with appropriate comparisons showing the claimed shortfall against specialist models.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Contemporary evaluations establish dependable performance in an asserted deficient capability, or show frontier models matching or exceeding relevant specialist models on matched tasks. Contrary results for one component can support a mixed assessment if another component is supported.
